issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Device issue requesting support for a data element that differentiates user-entered from AIDC-entered Device.udiCarrier data.
initial_application: The 2017 Device UDI commit series 2bd8c95642d3, 05a8652714ff, and d9163a93a7ba explicitly cited [11050] and [11049] and introduced UDI carrier source/model updates, examples with entryType, and spreadsheet changes later retained through source refactors.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Device.udiCarrier.entryType is a 0..1 code with a required binding to ValueSet/udi-entry-type, and UDIEntryType codes distinguish barcode, RFID, and electronic transmission from manual, card, self-reported, and unknown entry. FHIR-11049 is the same change family because it clarified AIDC carrier support. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build inputs already convey the requested rule and supporting terminology.
